integrity: The two supplied exhaustive programs were executed and their output logs retained; scientific correctness and novelty were evaluated in a same-model review only, without independent external auditing or certification.
scientific_limitations: Finite theorem determining the sharp minimum and all order-five marked graph types for simultaneous aggregate consensus-basin gain and loss of prior members. Applies only to connected simple graphs before and after deletion, synchronous binary open-neighbor majority and incumbent tie retention; it does not classify larger graphs or other update rules. The 2000 nonmonotonicity of democratic majority correctness is credited; an unindexed historical enumeration remains a priority risk.
title: Five vertices are necessary and sufficient for a majority-consensus gain–loss paradox
